title: Object Definition
description: Schema for ALIS data-driven world objects and skeletal actors (doors, furniture, containers, characters, NPCs, creatures). Skeletal actors use the same definition with optional kind/role/visibility fields on meshes and SkeletalAssembly capability for lifecycle orchestration. IMPORTANT: Field names must match USTRUCT property names (case-insensitive) for FJsonObjectConverter auto-parsing. Every object JSON file MUST include a $schema field pointing to this file (relative path). See FObjectMeshEntry in ObjectDefinition.h.

id.description: Unique object identifier (used for FPrimaryAssetId). RENAME WARNING: Referenced by loot profiles (objectId), storage seedEntries, dialogue actions (inventory.consume), and dialogue conditions (inventory check). Run scripts/ue/check/gameplay/projectmind/validate_data.py after renaming.

spawnClass.description: Optional actor class path override for spawned parent actor. Accepted forms: Blueprint asset path (/Game/Path/BP_Npc) or native class path (/Script/Module.ClassName). Invalid values are ignored and fallback spawn class is used.

attachToComponentTag.description: Optional component tag used as default attachment root for generated meshes. If omitted, ObjectAttachRoot tag is used when present, otherwise actor root.

actorTags.description: Optional actor tags applied to spawned actor instance. Useful for scenario wiring via tag lookup.

actorScale.description: Uniform actor scale applied to root component. Scales entire actor (capsule, meshes, grooms). Default 1.0.

meshes.description: Mesh components that compose this object. Supports static meshes, skeletal meshes, and customizable skeletal meshes.

id.description: Mesh ID for capability scope references (e.g., 'body', 'door', 'panel')

asset.description: Asset path to mesh (StaticMesh or SkeletalMesh). Runtime casts loaded UObject to determine component type. Accepts short path (/ProjectObject/Mesh/SM_X) or full soft path. Generator normalizes to full soft path.

parent.description: Optional parent mesh ID. If specified, this mesh attaches to the parent mesh instead of actor root. Parent mesh must be defined earlier in the array.

transform.description: Relative transform from actor root. Uses UE ImportText string format.

location.description: Relative position in UE format: (X=val Y=val Z=val)

rotation.description: Relative rotation in UE format: (P=pitch Y=yaw R=roll) degrees

scale.description: Scale in UE format: (X=val Y=val Z=val)

physics.description: Physics simulation settings. Applied when explicitly enabled by the object definition or when Chaos constraints are used.

massKg.description: Mass override in kg (default: auto from mesh)

enableGravity.description: Enable gravity (default: false for constrained objects)

materials.description: Optional material overrides. Array index maps to material slot index. Supports short paths (auto-normalized) or full soft object paths. Empty array or omitted = use mesh defaults.

animClass.description: Optional AnimBlueprint class path for skeletal meshes. Ignored for static meshes. Sets USkeletalMeshComponent::AnimClass at spawn. Uses class path format (/Game/Path/ABP_Name).

bindingAsset.description: Groom binding asset path. Required when kind=Groom. Links GroomAsset to parent SkeletalMesh skeleton. Path to UGroomBindingAsset.

retargetTag.description: IK Retargeter lookup tag. Inserted as first ComponentTag on the mesh. ABP_WorldBodyRetarget reads ComponentTags[0] to resolve which IKRetargeter asset to use from its IKRetargeter_Map. Must match a key in that map.

kind.description: Optional component type override. When omitted, auto-detects from asset (StaticMesh or SkeletalMesh). Required for types that cannot be auto-detected.

role.description: Optional semantic role for assembly orchestration. Only valid when SkeletalAssembly capability is present. The assembly component reads roles to build the component graph.

visibility.description: Optional visibility policy for assembly orchestration. Only valid when SkeletalAssembly capability is present.

triggers.description: Trigger shape components (Box, Sphere, Capsule). Used by capabilities like EnvironmentEffect for overlap detection. Created during spawn between meshes and capabilities.

id.description: Trigger ID. Capabilities reference this via TriggerComponentName property.

kind.description: Shape type for the trigger volume.

extent.description: Box half-extent in UE format: (X=val Y=val Z=val). Only used when kind=Box.

radius.description: Radius in cm. Used for Sphere and Capsule kinds.

halfHeight.description: Half-height in cm. Only used for Capsule kind.

location.description: Relative position in UE format: (X=val Y=val Z=val)

rotation.description: Relative rotation in UE format: (P=pitch Y=yaw R=roll) degrees

postProcess.description: Optional post-process settings applied inside this trigger's bounds. UPostProcessComponent attached to shape inherits volume bounds automatically. Component-level fields (priority, blendRadius, blendWeight) configure the volume. The 'settings' object is auto-parsed into FPostProcessSettings via FJsonObjectConverter -- any UE post-process property name is valid (bOverride_* flags set automatically for non-default values). 'material' adds a post-process material blendable.

priority.description: Post-process priority. Higher overrides lower when volumes overlap.

blendRadius.description: World-space blend radius in cm around the volume edge.

blendWeight.description: Effect intensity. 0 = no effect, 1 = full effect.

material.description: Post process material asset path (e.g., /ProjectObject/Path/PP_Fog_Mat_Inst). Applied as blendable.

materialWeight.description: Blend weight for the post process material.

settings.description: FPostProcessSettings fields. Any UPROPERTY name from FPostProcessSettings is valid (e.g., SceneColorTint, VignetteIntensity, ColorSaturation, BloomIntensity). bOverride_* flags are set automatically. Uses UE ImportText format for struct values.

capabilities.description: Capability components attached to this object. Validated by FDefinitionValidator::ValidateObjectCapabilities.

type.description: Capability ID from FCapabilityRegistry (e.g., 'Lockable', 'Hinged', 'SkeletalAssembly', 'MotionMatching'). One registry for all capabilities.

scope.description: Target scope: ['actor'] for per-actor, or mesh IDs ['door'] for per-mesh. VALIDATED: IDs must exist in meshes array.

properties.description: Property overrides (string values parsed via FProperty::ImportText). Sliding: use Position mode (OpenPosition) OR Direction mode (SlideDirection+OpenDistance), not both. MotionMode defaults to "Kinematic" if omitted. Only the selected mode config is applied; other mode keys are ignored. Chaos constraints are opt-in via MotionMode = "Chaos". Chaos config values (HingePivotLocal, SliderPivotLocal, motor params) do not enable Chaos by themselves. Nested config fields are supported by name (e.g., Stiffness maps to KinematicConfig.Stiffness). See Plugins/Systems/ProjectMotionSystem/docs/motion_modes.md for details.
properties.x-alis-notes: Asset references (TSoftObjectPtr) require full UE object path: /Mount/Path/Asset.Asset (e.g., /ProjectObject/Dir/DLG_X.DLG_X). Simple types (float, bool, FVector, FGameplayTag) use ImportText format. RENAME WARNING: DialogueTreeAsset and AudioPresetAsset reference generated UAsset paths from DLG_*.json and AUDIO_*.json. Renaming those files requires updating all object definitions that reference them.

sections.description: Optional data sections for other systems (inventory, storage, quest). See layer_contract.md.

item.description: Item section: identity + rules + behavior refs for inventory/UI/GAS systems.

iconCode.description: Icon font codepoint (Game Icons font, e.g. \uF88D)

volume.description: Volume in liters for container capacity

tags.description: Item categorization tags. String (comma-separated) or array format.

canBeDropped.description: Whether item can be dropped from inventory

magnitudes.description: SetByCaller tag to magnitude mapping for consumable effects

grantedAbilities.description: C++ ability class paths to grant when equipped (e.g., /Script/Module.GA_Class)

grantedEffects.description: GameplayEffect asset paths to apply when equipped

maxWeight.description: Max weight for this container (0 = unlimited)

maxVolume.description: Max volume for this container (0 = unlimited)

storage.description: Storage section: canonical world-storage data for searchable props and persistent containers.

gridSize.description: Grid size as 'X,Y' or object form { x, y }.

maxWeight.description: Max weight for this container in kg (0 = unlimited)

maxVolume.description: Max volume for this container in liters (0 = unlimited)

maxCells.description: Hard cap on total occupied cells (0 = unlimited)

persistent.description: Whether this world container persists across sessions

containerSlotId.description: Stable logical slot id for actors exposing multiple containers

seedEntries.description: Exact authored entries placed into the container on initialization

objectId.description: ObjectDefinition PrimaryAssetId (e.g., 'ObjectDefinition:WaterBottle'). RENAME WARNING: Must match object definition id field. Mismatch causes silent spawn failure.

lootProfileId.description: Optional shared loot profile primary asset id for randomized fill (e.g. 'LootProfileDefinition:Scavenge_SmallConsumables'). RENAME WARNING: Must match profileId in loot_profile JSON files.

animation.description: Animation config for skeletal assembly definitions.

customization.description: Customization config for skeletal assembly definitions.

view.description: View/camera config for skeletal assembly definitions. Camera is policy, not a mesh entry.

cameraParent.description: Camera parent component or attach point (e.g. 'Root', 'Head')

relativeOffset.description: Camera relative offset in UE format: (X=val Y=val Z=val)

neckOffset.description: Neck bone offset from camera in actor-local space: (X=val Y=val Z=val). Used by LocalBodyAnimInstance to lock neck_01 relative to camera.
